## Headers

- [Async.h](Async.h): declares `AsyncError`, `AsyncPromise`, `Async`, `delay`
- [CallAfter.h](CallAfter.h): Joins callAfter's scheduler thread and drops every callback it still held; the next callAfter starts a new one. (declares `stopCallAfterScheduler`)
- [EventLoop.h](EventLoop.h): declares `EventLoop`, `getEventLoop`, `runEventLoop`, `runEventLoopFor`, `callAsync`, `callAfter`, `stopEventLoop`, `attachCurrentThreadAsMain`, `detachCurrentThreadAsMain`, `stopProcessRootLoop`, `isEventLoopRunning`, `scheduleStartup`, `runEventLoopUntil`
- [TaskSemaphore.h](TaskSemaphore.h): declares `BinarySemaphore`, `TaskSemaphore`
- [Thread.h](Thread.h): Applied on the new thread before its body runs; an empty name leaves it unnamed. (declares `ThreadOptions`, `Thread`)
- [ThreadPool.h](ThreadPool.h): declares `ThreadPoolOptions`, `PoolTask`, `ThreadPool`, `TaskGroup`, `stopSharedThreadPool`
- [ThreadRealtime.h](ThreadRealtime.h): umbrella header: includes 1 headers
- [ThreadUtils.h](ThreadUtils.h): declares `assertMainThread`, `isMainThread`, `currentThreadId`, `ThreadPriority`, `setCurrentThreadName`, `setCurrentThreadPriority`, `fitThreadName`, `RealtimeOptions`, `setCurrentThreadRealtime`, `endCurrentThreadRealtime`
- [Timer.h](Timer.h): declares `Timer`
